content: पुरस्कारः .²1 Placing before or in front. .²2 Preference. .²3 Treating with honour, showing respect, deference. .²4 Worshipping. .²5 Accompanying, attending. .²6 Preparing. .²7 Arranging, making complete or perfect. .²8 Attacking. .²9 Accusation. .²10 Consecrating .²11 Anticipating, expecting. .²12 (At the end of <ab>comp.</ab>) Preceded or accompanied by. .²13 Sprinkling with holy water. .²14 Acceptance. .²15 Manifesting oneself; कर्महेतुपुरस्कारं भूतेषु परिवर्तते <ls>Mb. 12. 19. 19</ls>.
